decided.text: Paint sells at 3.5x, MPU at 2.5x, every other scope 2.8x; the floor binds every layer
MPU cost is $4,500, or $5,500 with relocation
Paint home sizes 1,350 / 1,800 / 3,000 sq ft; above that is a custom scope
Below the floor is unreachable: clamped scopes stay at the floor, others carry the target
Call it the proposal-wide multiplier, never job-wide
Each extra story adds $1,000 cost to paint

brief.goal: The Scope Pricing calculator prices exterior paint by home size and MPU at new costs, with per-scope multipliers and one proposal-wide multiplier the agent controls.

lastCommit.subject: fix(calculators): below-floor and no-cost copy name the proposal-wide control and a costed scope; solver result never under the floor; shift copy exact
